full_judgment: 43. Turning to the judgment of reversal as passed by the learned District Judge, Lakshmipur, we are of the view that he has failed to grasp the facts of the case and the law bearing with it. He totally failed to assess and evaluate the facts as well as the evidence on record which led him to reverse the findings of the learned trial Court.
